name: dataforseo/v3/ai_optimization/llm_mentions/multi_target_metrics/live
description: Mention metrics for 2 to 10 domains or keywords side by side, for share-of-voice comparisons in AI answers.

targets.description: Array of 2 to 10 objects, each with a `key` label and a `target` array of domain or keyword entities.

platform.description: Optional: "google" (AI Overviews) or "chat_gpt". Omit for both.

input_schema.description: Request parameters forwarded to DataForSEO /v3/ai_optimization/llm_mentions/multi_target_metrics/live. See DataForSEO docs for full schema.

pricing.note: Billed per call from metered usage; the reference price is typical.
